So the algorithm:
1. Identify the 9 line and the side with space. Direction is away from the 9 line.
2. Identify the connected component (8-connected) that touches the 9 line on that side. This is the moving component.
3. Find the maximum shift k in the direction such that no cell of the moving component would land on a stationary object (non-moving component) or go out of bounds. (Note: if a cell would land on another cell of the moving component, that's fine, it's rigid.)
